release_notes:
Ready Messages log: fix 6-entry cap counting separators as entries (follow-up to 1.0.74).

Root cause: Tk Text widget tag-range ends have right-gravity semantics. When _refresh_separators inserts a separator line at the exact position where an entry's row_* tag ends (the start of the next Tk line), that tag silently extends to cover the separator line as well. _trim_log_to_max_entries was scanning every line for row_recent1/row_recent2/row_plain tags, so each separator adjacent to an entry was counted twice -- once for the entry, once for the separator that had the bled tag. With 6 real entries + 5 separators, the effective count came out as ~11; 'keep last 6' then discarded the oldest ~5 lines, leaving only ~4 real entries visible.

Fix: after scanning all lines for row_* tags, filter out any line that also carries the _separator_row tag. Only lines that have a row tag but NOT _separator_row are real entries. This is a one-line list-comprehension added after the scan loop and is non-invasive -- it does not change tag assignment, insertion order, or any other log behavior.
